blocks.text: Team preview of the Portland Trail Blazers ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last season: 42-40, lost to the San Antonio Spurs in the first round of the playoffs. Coach: Micah Nori (first-time NBA coach, hired on June 23). Season opener: Oct. 21 vs. the Phoenix Suns. Departures: F Jerami Grant, F Kris Murray, G Matisse Thybulle. Additions: G Ja Morant, C Branden Carlson, F Micah Potter, F Jeremy Sochan.
